SOCIAL · HYPER-CASUAL

06  ·  MONETISATION
OUR OWN AD ENGINE

Ad-funded, subscription-funded,
or both.

The same platform monetises two ways: an in-house advertising engine with rewarded placements, or a DCB subscription that bundles the whole catalogue. The operator chooses per market.

REWARDED
In-house ad engine
Rewarded ads are served by our own engine — not a third-party SDK bolted onto someone else's platform.
FORMATS
Pre, mid, post-roll
Full-format advertising support alongside rewarded placements.
MEDIATION
25+ networks
Programmatic mediation with priority optimisation, so fill and yield are managed, not left to chance.
SUBSCRIPTION
DCB all-you-can-eat
Where subscription suits the market, the catalogue is billed on the operator's carrier rail.
